[[Madison Square Garden]] | champion = | tourney = | tourney_result = }} {{2023–24 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team''' represented [[St. John's University (New York City)|St. John's University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by [[Rick Pitino]], in his first year at the school, and played their home games at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|Red Storm]] finished the season 17–14, 7–13 in [[2022–23 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in eighth place. They defeated [[2022–23 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]] in the opening round of the [[2023 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2022–23 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]]. On March 10, 2023, the school fired head coach [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]] for cause.{{Cite web |title=St. John's fires Mike Anderson; Rick Pitino reportedly top candidate |url=https://www.foxsports.com/stories/college-basketball/st-johns-fires-mike-anderson-rick-pitino-reportedly-top-candidate |access-date=2023-03-23 |website=FOX Sports |language=en-US}} Anderson disputed the assertion that his firing was for cause, and filed a notice of intent to arbitrate seeking the guaranteed money that was owed to him on his contract, as well as an additional $34.2 million in punitive damages.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/37603396/fired-hoops-coach-mike-anderson-seeks-46m-st-johns|title=Fired Hoops Coach Mike Anderson Seeks $45.6M from St. John's|last1=Medcalf|first1=Myron|website=ESPN|date=May 11, 2023|access-date=November 1, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/arkansas/hogs-mens-basketball/mike-anderson-lawsuit-seeks-46-million-mental-issues-st-johns-rick-pitino-iona-kentucky|title=Mike Anderson Lawsuit Seeks $46 Million, Reveals Strong Supporting Evidence|website=Sports Illustrated Fan Nation: All Hogs|last1=Smith|first1=Keith|date=May 11, 2023|access-date=November 16, 2023}} On March 20, the school named [[Basketball Hall of Fame|Hall of Fame]]r Rick Pitino as the team's new head coach.{{Cite web |title=Rick Pitino hired at St. John's: Hall of Fame coach returning to Big East after three seasons leading Iona |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/rick-pitino-hired-at-st-johns-hall-of-fame-coach-returning-to-big-east-after-three-seasons-leading-iona/ |access-date=2023-03-23 |website=CBSSports.com |date=March 20, 2023 |language=en}} == Offseason == === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
